name: MonarchMemberRow
title: MemberRow
wrapsNative: androidx.compose.material3.ListItem for the identity with MonarchAvatar and MonarchBadge; MonarchRolePicker in its compact layout (androidx.compose.material3.ExposedDropdownMenuBox) for the role; MonarchButton for Resend invite and Remove; androidx.compose.material3.AlertDialog for the confirmation
summary: One member of a workspace, space or channel: avatar, name, email, role, status (active, invited, suspended) and actions that are confirmed and may run for a while.
whenToUse: In a list of people with a role that some viewers may change, including pending invitations with resend and revoke.
whenNotToUse: For choosing people to add, use a searchable picker. For a dense table with many columns per person, use a data table with MonarchAvatar cells. For choosing a role with descriptions on its own, use MonarchRolePicker.
api: @Composable public fun MonarchMemberRow(name: String, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, image: Painter? = null, email: String? = null, meta: String? = null, presence: MonarchPresenceStatus? = null, status: MonarchMemberRowStatus = MonarchMemberRowStatus.Active, role: String? = null, roles: List<MonarchRoleOption<String>> = emptyList(), badges: List<String> = emptyList(), self: Boolean = false, enabled: Boolean = true, canChangeRole: Boolean? = null, canRemove: Boolean? = null, removeConsequences: List<String> = emptyList(), onRoleChange: (suspend (String) -> Unit)? = null, onResend: (suspend () -> Unit)? = null, onRemove: (suspend () -> Unit)? = null, removeIcon: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null, labels: MonarchMemberRowLabels = MonarchMemberRowLabels(), actions: (@Composable FlowRowScope.() -> Unit)? = null)
public enum class MonarchMemberRowStatus { Active, Invited, Suspended }

public class MonarchMemberRowLabels(you: String? = null, invited: String? = null, suspended: String? = null, presence: ((MonarchPresenceStatus) -> String)? = null, roleLabel: ((String) -> String)? = null, chooseRole: String? = null, resend: String? = null, resendLabel: ((String) -> String)? = null, resent: String? = null, remove: ((String) -> String)? = null, revoke: ((String) -> String)? = null, removeTitle: ((String) -> String)? = null, revokeTitle: ((String) -> String)? = null, removeDescription: String? = null, revokeDescription: String? = null, removeConfirm: String? = null, revokeConfirm: String? = null, cancel: String? = null, failed: String? = null)

options.name: name
options.description: The display name; also seeds the avatar's initials and color. For an invitation, the email.

options.name: modifier
options.description: The modifier of the row.

options.name: image
options.description: The avatar picture, loaded by the app. Initials show without it.

options.name: email
options.description: Email or handle under the name, shortened in the middle.

options.name: meta
options.description: Extra detail: joined date, invite expiry, availability.

options.name: presence
options.description: Presence dot on the avatar, also read in words.

options.name: status
options.description: Invited adds an info badge, Resend invite and Revoke invite; suspended a warning badge and a muted name.

options.name: role
options.description: The value of the member's role, one of roles.

options.name: roles
options.description: The roles allowed here (the role picker's type). Titles also show for a read-only role; disabled options cannot be picked.

options.name: badges
options.description: Extra neutral badges after the name, such as "Guest".

options.name: self
options.description: The signed-in person: a "You" badge after the name; role picker and Remove hidden by default.

options.name: enabled
options.description: Disables every control in the row.

options.name: canChangeRole
options.description: Shows the role picker. By default when onRoleChange is given and it is not your own row.

options.name: canRemove
options.description: Shows Remove. By default when onRemove is given and it is not your own row.

options.name: removeConsequences
options.description: Lines added under the text of the remove confirmation.

options.name: onRoleChange
options.description: Makes the role a picker. The new role shows while it runs and until role changes; a thrown error restores the previous role and shows the error in the row.

options.name: onResend
options.description: Sends an invitation again; shown for invited rows. "Invite sent again." is shown and announced when it returns.

options.name: onRemove
options.description: Removes the member or revokes the invitation after a confirmation. The app removes the row; a thrown error is shown in the row.

options.name: removeIcon
options.description: An icon before the word of the remove button. Monarch bundles no icons.

options.name: labels
options.description: Replacements for every built-in string; functions receive the member's name.

options.name: actions
options.description: More trailing controls after Remove, such as a menu button. Name them after the member.

states.name: invited
states.description: Info badge "Invited", a Resend invite button, and Remove becomes Revoke invite.

states.name: suspended
states.description: Warning badge "Suspended" and the name in the muted text color.

states.name: self
states.description: A "You" badge after the name; the role is text and Remove is hidden unless canChangeRole or canRemove say otherwise.

states.name: read-only role
states.description: Without the role picker the role title is a muted line under the name.

states.name: busy
states.description: A circular progress indicator beside the role picker, which is disabled, while onRoleChange runs; Resend and Remove show their loading state while their action runs.

states.name: error
states.description: The failure under the identity in the danger strong color, announced.

states.name: done
states.description: "Invite sent again." under the identity in the success strong color, announced.

appearance: A transparent Material 3 list item with the avatar at the start, the name in the strong body style (muted when suspended), email and meta in the muted caption style, status badges in the info and warning tones; the controls sit under it. Notices use the danger strong and success strong roles. All colors are theme roles, so dark and both high-contrast themes follow.
platformNotes: Same parameters as iOS, with Android conventions: the picture is a Painter, isSelf is self, actions are suspending functions, and the extra controls are a FlowRowScope slot. The role picker is MonarchRolePicker's compact exposed dropdown, labelled "Role for <name>", instead of the web's native select and iOS's menu Picker; it always sits under the identity, because a phone row has no room beside it. The web keeps the remove dialog open while onRemove runs and shows its error there; the Material 3 AlertDialog closes when confirmed, so the Remove button shows progress and the error appears in the row, as on iOS. Consequences are lines of the dialog's text. iOS offers swipe actions in a List; Android has no standard swipe actions for list rows, so Remove and Resend are buttons only. The web's MemberList is not needed: a Column or LazyColumn holds the rows. Monarch bundles no icons, so the notice has no icon; its text carries the meaning.
accessibility: The identity is one TalkBack element: the name ("Priya Raman, You") as its name, and status, presence, badges, a read-only role, email and meta as its state description.
The avatar is decorative next to the visible name; presence is read in words.
The role picker is labelled "Role for <name>"; Resend is read "Resend invite, <name>" and Remove "Remove <name>" or "Revoke invite for <name>".
Resend success and every failure are shown as text and announced through a polite live region, not color alone.
Resend and Remove keep 48dp touch targets.
edgeCases: A role value that is not in roles is shown as its raw value when read-only; the picker shows "Choose a role" for it.
With no role yet, the picker shows "Choose a role" until one is picked.
A second change while a role change runs is ignored; the picker is disabled until it finishes.
Errors with a message are shown in its words; other errors show "That did not work. Try again.".
Long names wrap to two lines and emails are shortened in the middle.

examples.title: Members with editable roles
examples.template:
Column {
    MonarchMemberRow(
        name = {{people.0.name}},
        email = {{people.0.email}},
        role = ownerRole,
        roles = roles,
        self = {{people.0.self}},
    )
    MonarchMemberRow(
        name = {{people.1.name}},
        email = {{people.1.email}},
        role = secondRole,
        roles = roles,
        onRoleChange = { next -> secondRole = next },
        onRemove = {},
    )
    MonarchMemberRow(
        name = {{people.2.name}},
        email = {{people.2.email}},
        role = thirdRole,
        roles = roles,
        onRoleChange = { next -> thirdRole = next },
        onRemove = {},
    )
}
examples.code:
Column {
    MonarchMemberRow(
        name = "Priya Raman",
        email = "priya@example.com",
        role = ownerRole,
        roles = roles,
        self = true,
    )
    MonarchMemberRow(
        name = "Jonas Weber",
        email = "jonas@example.com",
        role = secondRole,
        roles = roles,
        onRoleChange = { next -> secondRole = next },
        onRemove = {},
    )
    MonarchMemberRow(
        name = "Amara Okafor",
        email = "amara@example.com",
        role = thirdRole,
        roles = roles,
        onRoleChange = { next -> thirdRole = next },
        onRemove = {},
    )
}
